title: Canary Wharf · city, traffic & UAVs
description: Detailed Canary Wharf core, unified ground, recorded dense vehicle traffic and Wave PDE delivery routes.
limits: Controlled scenarios, not observed weather or live traffic.
Wind: uniform west-to-east 5 m/s inflow; 16 m grid; transient inviscid model.
Temperature: clear-sky 20 °C ambient and estimated uniform materials; 32 m grid; forced by frozen final wind.
Traffic: seeded passenger-car demand and inferred signal timings; flat bridge/tunnel elevations.
Wind particles illustrate the sampled flow; they are not recorded physical particles.
© OpenStreetMap contributors; Overture Maps Foundation. Heights and architectural detail include estimates.
Wind colours saturate above 6 m/s; underlying recorded values are unchanged.
UAV stations are demonstration sites; canopy and real-world landing access are unverified. Aircraft share paths without fleet collision scheduling.
